A few useful answers.

Can I try it on this website?

Yes. The interactive sample is scripted. Work in an engineering application requires the installed Vector OS app and an available connector.

Which software can I connect?

Check the software directory and download page for the current build and supported hosts. A directory listing does not mean a connector is available.

How do I get access?

Use Join the beta for Windows access information. Email updates are optional.
